content.subject: Modern issuer processing and reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi Chermaine,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. I'm reaching out because modern issuer processing may be an area we could help with.

I read your post about building modern issuer processing, especially your point about legacy payments not fitting fintech today. I imagine keeping payment reconciliation aligned across multiple markets can become increasingly time-consuming.

We extract transaction data from disparate sources and reconcile it against settlement records, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
